opener_episode.why: No recent episodes exist. If a pitch is sent anyway, this episode's theme (street art after the NFT bubble) is the closest match to Avery's ArtGrails/NFT story and Alec Monopoly work, but it is ~3 years old and should be framed as 'a revival episode' idea.

angles.headline: Street art to global brand: the Alec Monopoly playbook
angles.pitch: How Avery developed Alec Monopoly from street artist into a global brand with sold-out shows from New York to Morocco and major brand partnerships.
angles.builds_on: Show's core theme of street artists and collectors

angles.headline: What survived the NFT bust: lessons from ArtGrails
angles.pitch: Avery's ArtGrails dropped work with Ozuna (Rolling Stone) and sold Michael Cohen's prison badge as an NFT (Vanity Fair), a candid look at what street-art collectors should keep from the NFT era.
angles.builds_on: #40 Adrian Dominic 'Getting out of NFTs' and the show's NFT-intersection premise

angles.headline: Collecting street-rooted artists early
angles.pitch: Avery was an early champion of Hebru Brantley and Jammie Holmes; how collectors spot and back artists before the market does.
